description: Repo-controlled repair payload for pioarduino's tool-scons. The C3 custom-core rebuild reinstalls scons-local-4.11.1 mid-build and relinks firmware.elf against an incomplete copy that is missing SCons.Tool.FortranCommon (imported by SCons.Tool.linkCommon.smart_link). These are the exact modules that import chain needs, vendored from the pinned pioarduino bundle so no network fetch is required.

provenance.source: pioarduino tool-scons (scons-local-4.11.1), files copied verbatim (MIT, SCons Foundation)
